title: Documentation changed: Google — Common crawlers (Google-Extended etc.)
summary:
This documentation page was edited with no announcement.
ADDED:
/archive Affected products Crawling preferences addressed to the Googlebot user agent affect Google Search (including Discover and all Google Search features), as well as other products such as Google Images, Video mode, Google News, and Discover.
/archive/moons.jpg Affected products Crawling preferences addressed to the Googlebot-Image user agent affect Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and all features in Google Search where images, logos, and favicons are presented.
Last updated 2026-10-15 UTC.
